name: Navigator, Lighting layouts and pointer tools remain usable
description: Aspect/overlay alignment, full zoom, task persistence and mouse access at compact widths.

planSteps.description: Use a fresh isolated desktop context at 1280x900. Open restored Studio. With Pen size 1, draw a small mark; retain every byte of the visible composite canvas. Unsupported exact pixel/DOM inspection is BLOCKED, never a visibility-only pass.

Choose Animation. Set Navigator zoom slider to 6400. Measure navigator canvas intrinsic/display dimensions and its viewport outline; click navigator local point (140,56), drag to (84,42), press Right, Shift+Down, Enter.

Navigator display ratio matches intrinsic 224x112 (2:1). Slider reports 6400. Outline centers are respectively (140,56), (84,42), (87.5,42), (87.5,70), (112,56), within 0.01px. The keyboard target is the overview button. Pixels remain unchanged.

Choose Lighting; wait for the actual Add light and depth heading and Lighting controls. Save artwork, clear sessionStorage only, reload and await restoration. Open Palette; View options menu → Arrange... → save Color desk; switch to Animation, then back to Color desk. Reload.

Lighting selects PixiTools and its Lighting domain after reload. Animation selects Layers. The saved Color desk selects Palette after switching and reload. Exact artwork bytes still match. Report storage/reset constraints explicitly.

At widths 1024,1280,1600 with height900 choose Drawing, Pen and draw a fresh short stroke. Click the header Undo and Redo buttons with the mouse, comparing before/after pixels each time. At 1280 hover Dither until its animated preview is visible, click Dither and immediately draw a size1 Bayer2x2 density0.5 stroke from pixel(0,8) directly to(20,8).

Every mouse Undo restores the previous bytes and Redo the stroke bytes; Drawing controls cannot block Undo. Activating Dither dismisses its preview before drawing. Dither alpha is 255 at even x and 0 at odd x on row8, including both endpoints. Missing intermediate pixels fail. No keyboard tool-selection workaround is permitted for this check.
